app_title: CIVICPRO - Civil Engineering Multi-Project Command Center

theme.mode: light/dark dual mode with professional engineering aesthetic

component_strategy.framework: React + Tailwind CSS + Shadcn/UI primitives + Recharts + Lucide icons
component_strategy.styling: Cardless or sharp 8px border-radius, dense data correlation, high contrast badges, and clean technical engineering workspace aesthetics.

motion.transition_rules: transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease; no universal all transitions.

image_urls.description: Yellow crane near building during daytime for hero showcase
Two workers discussing plans on a sandy construction site with safety gear
Several cranes above buildings for project portfolio cover

accessibility.contrast_standards: APCA and WCAG AA compliant (minimum 4.5:1 text, 3:1 interactive elements)
accessibility.focus_states: Visible focus ring with high contrast and ring-2 ring-amber-500
accessibility.aria_labels: All interactive buttons, dialogs, and tables include aria-label and data-testid attributes

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes. Implement multi-project workspace switching, Gantt timeline tracking, daily/weekly site reporting with struggle and risk assessment, photo/document attachments, and exportable PDF/CSV reports. Follow Swiss engineering high-contrast aesthetic with Outfit and Inter fonts.
